title: A3 sheet: frame, title block, page setup, plot, deliver
summary: Put a model-space drawing on an ISO A3 paper layout with an ISO 5457 frame and an ISO 7200 title block, plot it, prove the PDF is A3 from its own MediaBox, and deliver the bundle.

notes: The sheet is a new paper layout; the source file is never overwritten (the delivery exports a copy).
The viewport sits inside the A3 frame above the title block (paper mm); view_center is the model point it shows and scale its plot scale.
The headless engine renders the PDF through matplotlib (the pdf extra); a live seat plots through AutoCAD.
